candidates.proposition: Evolution can favor survival-enhancing irrational beliefs, so human cognition need not have evolved primarily for rationality or truth.

candidates.proposition: If evolution selects cognition for survival rather than truth, then naturalism undermines confidence in the beliefs produced by evolved cognition.
